title: The phase harness names the first click out of tolerance and never passes on silence
description:
As a developer, I want the harness to say exactly where phase was lost, so that a failure points at a moment I can reproduce.

Spec file: `features/link/phase.feature`.

```gherkin
Feature: The phase harness reports failures clearly

  Scenario: A click out of tolerance
    Given the harness runs with a tolerance of 0.1 ms, which the engine cannot meet
    When the run ends
    Then the harness fails
    And the report names the first click out of tolerance: its time in the run, its session beat, its error in ms, and the script step before it

  Scenario: No clicks at all
    Given Apricity never joins the session
    When the run ends
    Then the harness fails with "no clicks heard from Apricity" rather than passing on an empty list

  Scenario: The run is bounded
    Given a run of 10 minutes
    Then the harness stops by itself after at most 11 minutes, whatever happens
```
